mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 2150 thousand units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which boosts near-term corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 117.0 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating business conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 117.0, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 50% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 191.0 combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers forward-looking rate hike expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 191.0 and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payroll growth signals a labor market that is both tightening and expanding, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with rising residential investment (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in less than 50% of instances where both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
